ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَاجْعَلْ سَعْيَنَا مَشْكُوْرًا .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘j`al sa`yanā mashkūrā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and make our striving appreciated!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَلَقِّنَا نَضْرَةً وَسُرُوْرًا .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa laqqinā naḍratan wa surūrā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and give us splendor and happiness!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَلْقِ عَلَيْنَا مِنْكَ مَحَبَّةً وَنُوْرًا.
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa alqi `alaynā minka maḥabbatan wa Nūrā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and confer upon us from love and light from You!
